newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stock gains restrained by profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stock gains restrained by profit-taking.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were firmer at midday on Friday but gains were pared by profit-taking across the board, brokers said.
The all share index was 6.9 points up at 713.70 at midday. Hatton National Bank rose 33.75 rupees to 294, National Development Bank 11 rupees to 221, Aitken Spence & Co 7.50 to 145.

"The index is being restrained by profit-taking in almost every share. But the upward movement is continuing due to buying of pricey blue chips," said Shafi Waheed, a trader at CDIC Sasoon. Turnover was 67.5 million rupees on 1.8 million shares.
